Class MoleculeEdits

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeEdits
public final class MoleculeEdits extends Object
Copies or edits a molecule definition while keeping its name, matching rules, and other metadata.

    • apply

      public static MoleculeDef apply(String newId, MoleculeDef source, StructureEdits edits, boolean materialize)
      Applies structure edits to a source molecule definition, producing a new modified MoleculeDef.
      Parameters:
      newId - the new resource identifier for the resulting molecule
      source - the source MoleculeDef to edit
      edits - the StructureEdits to apply
      materialize - whether to materialize templates into concrete structures when edited
      Returns:
      a new MoleculeDef containing the applied edits
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if attempting to edit a template preview without materialization

    • snapshot

      public static com.google.gson.JsonObject snapshot(MoleculeDef source)
      Creates a self-contained source JSON snapshot of a molecule definition, retaining template families when the source has one.
      Parameters:
      source - the MoleculeDef to snapshot
      Returns:
      a JsonObject representing the complete molecule specification
